reasons: CS3263 is not open to BComp CS Hons students.
CS3103 prerequisite (CS2105) cannot be met before CS2102 in Y4S1 as CS2102 requires CS2105, creating a cycle or missing prerequisite for CS3103 if CS2105 is taken in Y4S1 or later.

CS4223 requires CS2106 and (CS3210 or CS3220 or CG3207). CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed) but also CS2106. CG3207 requires EE2026 and CG2028/EE2028, which are not completed. CS3220 is not offered. Thus CS4223 cannot be taken.
